nodes.name: SW1
nodes.startup_config:
hostname SW1
spanning-tree mode rstp
spanning-tree priority 4096
vlan 1,10,20
interface eth0
 switchport mode trunk
 switchport trunk allowed vlan 10,20
exit
interface eth1
 switchport mode trunk
 switchport trunk allowed vlan 10,20
exit
interface eth2
 switchport mode access
 switchport access vlan 10
 spanning-tree portfast
exit
